newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan jeweller Miki to quit clothes business - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan jeweller Miki to quit clothes business - paper.

text.p: Japanese jewellery retailer Miki Corp will withdraw from the apparel business as early as the end of April, a Japanese business daily reported in its evening edition on Wednesday.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Miki's clothing division had been incurring losses of about 10 billion yen annually over the last few years.
The company was also burdened with interest-bearing debts of about 140 billion yen as of the end of February, it said.
Under the restructuring plan, the firm will close around 400 clothing shops, the newspaper said.
Miki had also reached an agreement with Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd under which it would receive financial assistance from the bank, the newspaper said.
The firm is expected to post an extraordinary loss of about 25 billion to 26 billion yen for its business year which ended on February 28, the paper said.
